title: Hot Rolled Medium and High Tensile Structural Steel
scope: This standard covers hot rolled structural steel plates, sections, flats and bars intended for general structural purposes. It specifies grades, mechanical properties, chemical composition and delivery requirements.
description: Use this standard when procuring structural steel for buildings, bridges, equipment frames and other load-bearing applications. The grade and delivery condition should be stated in the procurement specification.

title: Dimensions for Hot Rolled Steel Beam, Column, Channel and Angle Sections
scope: This standard covers the nominal dimensions, mass and sectional properties of hot rolled steel beam, column, channel and angle sections. It applies to standard rolled sections used in structural fabrication.
description: Use this standard to define the dimensional designation of rolled steel sections alongside the material requirements in IS 2062. It helps suppliers and inspectors identify the required section consistently.

title: General Construction in Steel — Code of Practice
scope: This standard lays down general requirements for the design and construction of steel structures. It covers materials, design principles, fabrication, erection and inspection of steel structures.
description: Use this code when a procurement specification includes design or construction of load-bearing steelwork. It complements product standards by setting the structural design and execution requirements.

title: Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply
scope: This standard covers polyethylene pipes for the conveyance of water for human consumption and general purposes. It specifies dimensions, pressure classification, material requirements, performance and testing.
description: Use this standard for polyethylene water-supply pipes and fittings in buried or exposed installations. The pressure class, nominal outside diameter and intended water service should be included in the tender.

title: Polyethylene Pipes for Water Supply — Amendment 1
scope: This amendment changes specified requirements and test provisions for polyethylene pipes covered by IS 4984. It is to be read together with the parent standard.
description: Apply this amendment when the procurement specification cites IS 4984:2016. The amendment status should be checked during every refresh so the current requirements are not missed.

title: Steel Tubes, Tubulars and Other Wrought Steel Fittings — Part 1: Steel Tubes
scope: This standard covers requirements for welded and seamless plain-end and screwed steel tubes for water, gas, air and steam services. It specifies dimensions, mass, tolerances and tests.
description: Use this standard for wrought steel tubes in utility and service pipelines. Specify the tube type, nominal size, end condition and service medium to avoid ambiguity.

title: PVC Insulated Cables for Working Voltages up to and Including 1100 V
scope: This standard covers PVC insulated and PVC sheathed cables for fixed wiring and power distribution at working voltages up to and including 1100 V. It specifies construction, dimensions, electrical properties and tests.
description: Use this standard for low-voltage PVC-insulated power and wiring cables. The conductor material, number of cores, cross-sectional area and voltage rating should be stated in the purchase description.

title: Electrical Wiring Installations — Code of Practice
scope: This standard covers the selection and erection of electrical equipment for low-voltage electrical installations. It addresses protection, wiring systems, earthing, inspection and verification.
description: Use this code when a procurement requirement includes installation or wiring work in a building or facility. It provides installation requirements that are complementary to the cable product standard.

title: Specification for Industrial Safety Helmets
scope: This standard covers industrial safety helmets intended to protect the wearer against falling objects and consequential brain injury. It specifies construction, performance, marking and testing requirements.
description: Use this standard for helmets supplied as industrial personal protective equipment. The tender should identify the intended workplace hazards and require the prescribed marking and test evidence.

title: Personal Protective Equipment — Safety Footwear — Part 1: Requirements and Test Methods
scope: This standard specifies basic and additional requirements for safety footwear used to protect the wearer against injury. It includes construction, performance, marking and test methods.
description: Use this standard for protective footwear supplied for industrial or construction work. Select additional protection requirements according to the hazards identified in the procurement specification.

title: Plain and Reinforced Concrete — Code of Practice
scope: This standard deals with the general structural use of plain and reinforced concrete in buildings and structures. It covers design principles, material quality requirements, execution, quality control, and safety factors for reinforced concrete construction.
description: Primary Indian code of practice for plain and reinforced concrete design and structural safety. Use for all reinforced concrete construction and civil infrastructure tenders.

title: High Strength Deformed Steel Bars and Wires for Concrete Reinforcement
scope: This standard covers the requirements of deformed steel bars and wires for use as reinforcement in concrete in grades Fe 415, Fe 415D, Fe 500, Fe 500D, Fe 550, Fe 550D, and Fe 600.
description: Primary material standard for TMT reinforcement steel bars and rebar wire for concrete construction. Replaced legacy hot rolled deformed bars standard IS 1139.

title: Unplasticized PVC Pipes for Potable Water Supplies
scope: This standard covers unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (uPVC) pipes intended for potable water transportation and municipal water distribution networks.
description: Use for rigid PVC drinking water pipelines, irrigation distribution, and municipal water mains.

title: UPVC Pipes for Soil and Waste Discharge Systems Inside Buildings
scope: This standard specifies requirements for unplasticized polyvinyl chloride pipes used for soil and waste discharge systems (sanitary plumbing) inside buildings.
description: Standard for internal building sanitary plumbing, drainage stacks, and domestic soil and waste discharge pipes.

title: Switches for Domestic and Similar Purposes
scope: This standard applies to manually operated general purpose switches for AC only with a rated voltage not exceeding 440 V and a rated current not exceeding 63 A intended for domestic and similar fixed electrical installations.
description: Standard specification for domestic wall switches, flush switches, and electrical installation control switches.

title: Personal Protective Equipment — Part 2: Safety Footwear
scope: This standard specifies basic and additional (optional) requirements for safety footwear used for commercial and industrial work, including impact resistance, slip resistance, and thermal hazards.
description: Commercial safety boots and shoes meeting stringent industrial safety requirements with steel toe caps and slip-resistant soles.

title: Structural Steel (Standard Quality)
scope: This standard covers the requirements for standard quality structural steel intended for use in structural work, bridges and general engineering purposes. Superseded by IS 2062.
description: Legacy specification for structural steel plates and sections. Formally superseded and replaced by IS 2062:2011; obsolete for current public procurement.

title: Hot Rolled Deformed Bars for Concrete Reinforcement
scope: This standard covers requirements of hot-rolled deformed bars for concrete reinforcement. Formally superseded by IS 1786.
description: Historical specification for hot rolled deformed reinforcing bars. Formally superseded and replaced by IS 1786:2008 for all modern reinforcement applications.
